# Server Rules Welcome to Sector Vestige, a high roleplay (HRP) server! How we play here comes in two parts: [color=#ff0000]the Rules[/color], which admins enforce, and [color=#1b67a5]the Vestige Guidelines[/color], which describe the roleplay we are here for.
Please read the rules before you play. Admins will treat you as if you have read them, and some rules are zero tolerance, meaning a violation can lead to an indefinite ban without warning.
## The short version - Be kind to other players, in and out of character. - Play your character, not the game. - Build conflict through roleplay. Words first, violence last. - Only act on what your character could actually know. - When an admin messages you, answer them.
## The Rules - [textlink="Core Rules" link="CoreRules"]: apply at all times, including between rounds. - [textlink="Roleplay Rules" link="VestigeRoleplayRules"]: apply during a round. - [textlink="Silicon Rules" link="SiliconRules"]: apply only when you are playing a silicon.
## Vestige Guidelines [color=#1b67a5]The guidelines are not rules[/color], and nobody is banned for one. Admins may nudge you towards them, and behaviour that keeps coming back is handled under the rule it breaks. [color=#008000]Context matters[/color]: GM events and the situation around you can change how a guideline applies.
